title: If It's for My Daughter, I'd Even Defeat a Demon Lord
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Dale, a young accomplished adventurer, finds Latina, a small devil girl near death in the forest, and adopts her. Raised among the regulars of the Dancing Tabby Cat tavern, with its owners Kenneth and Rita as extra parent figures, Latina grows up gentle and clever while Dale balances dangerous work with fatherhood.
life_message: Love and protection of a child, whatever her origin, give life its meaning, and a caring community helps raise her.

content.note: Dale subdues demon beasts as an adventurer (Wikipedia); slice-of-life focus per AniList and MangaUpdates.
Latina is found nearly dead; mostly gentle tone.
Wikipedia says Latina later tells Dale she loves him and they marry, in the light novel; MangaUpdates lists Romance and a Loli tag. Whether the manga reaches this is unconfirmed (to verify).
Tavern setting (AniList Bar tag); drinking adults in background.
